Hi Jonas —

Thanks again for considering The Gilded Room for Redwood’s executive roundtable on June 18. Attached is our sample menu and a short checklist we use for guest travel/logistics. A few items we need to confirm from your side:

- NDA clearance for on-site staff: venue requires signed NDAs for any vendor/staff with behind-the-scenes access to private rooms. We can accept a single company NDA for ClearWave attendees or individual NDAs — which do you prefer?
- Travel reimbursements vs. stipends: for corporate guests we can coordinate a valet invoiced to Redwood or provide a per-guest stipend for ride-hailing. Let us know the preferred process so we can include line items in the contract.
- Dietary & seating spreadsheet: please send final guest list with dietary tags by June 8 so we can finalize plated vs. family-style service.
- Contract redlines: we have a standard venue contract; contracts@thegildedroom.com is ready to receive redlines. Deposit due 21 days prior.

Attached: GildedRoom_Catering_Sample.pdf

Best,

2) Travel: prefer a capped stipend per guest ($50 ride-hail) rather than invoicing valet. Keeps bookkeeping simpler for attendees who travel from SF core. Marcus, can you confirm events budget cap for stipends?

3) Guest list: I’ll share the first draft now (internal). Laura — can you consolidate dietary restrictions and add a column for arrival time and preferred seating (headshot table assignments)?

4) Contract: please send venue_contract_redlines.pdf to our legal. We will return redlines within 3 business days once Contracts has reviewed.

Rosa — last ask: does the venue require any staff background checks for night-of access? If so we’ll coordinate with ClearWave for names.
